name: TClarke plc
summary: TClarke plc, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a building services contractor in the United Kingdom. It engages in the design, installation, integration, and maintenance of the digital, mechanical, and electrical technologies and infrastructures. The company also provides mechanical and electrical contracting and related services to the construction industry and end users; and ICT services. In addition, it offers technologies in the areas of data centers, design for manufacture and assembly, IT infrastructures and networks, AV systems, fire, alarm and security systems, smart buildings, and offsite manufacture and prefabrication. Further, the company provides services in the areas of underground and over ground rails, civil and defense airports, healthcare, hospitals and research, school and universities, and prison and defense projects; and residential, hotels, refurbishment, and student accommodations. Additionally, it offers facilities management services; and mechanical and electrical contracting services for commercial offices, retails, leisure and stadiums, museum and galleries, and buildings. The company was founded in 1889 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.
